metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully converted /home/user/logo.png (773x941, RGB with alpha) to SVG in GIMP. Demonstrated skill navigating Image menu and export dialogs.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP, load images, navigate Image > Mode submenu to change color mode, export to PNG.
metadata.explanation: Chains image mode conversion with export. Agent must use Image > Mode > Grayscale to convert, then export as /home/user/logo_gray.png. Evaluator reads the PNG with PIL and checks mode is 'L' or 'LA' (grayscale, with or without alpha). Initial state does not pass since logo_gray.png does not exist in setup.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves /home/user/logo_gray.png from the VM and returns its PIL image mode.
Metric correctly checks for grayscale modes 'L' (no alpha) and 'LA' (with alpha), both valid GIMP grayscale export outputs.
File non-existence in initial setup ensures the negative control (do-nothing) does not pass.
All instruction requirements are covered: file existence at correct path, and correct grayscale color mode.
Error handling in getter ensures missing or unreadable files yield 0.0 score.
